description: KNOWN-UNSAFE / MISSING PROTECTION. On 2026-07-21 a single inbound turn spiralled to 28 outbound sends in one conversation. There is no installed hard transport budget on the live path: the per-turn outbound-send budget (#643, GATEWAY_TURN_SEND_BUDGET_ENABLED) is default OFF and the per-conversation bridge_post throttle is default OFF. This fixture's oracle caps a single turn at expected_logical_sends; the suite marks the enforcing assertion xfail(strict) until PR-3 activates the budget. Seam unit tests: test_gateway_send_throttle.py, test_turn_send_budget.py.
